items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Secures Exclusive Rights To In Vivo CAR T Autoimmune Programs
items.summary: Pfizer (NYSE:PFE) agreed to secure exclusive rights to Starna Therapeutics' in vivo CAR-T programs for autoimmune diseases outside Greater China. The agreement centers on Starna's proprietary in vivo CAR-T platform that aims to reprogram immune cells inside the body. Pfizer also gained options to expand access to Greater China and to license additional in vivo CAR-T programs from Starna.
